title: Restore missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (breaks 14 core FLA-writer tests on fresh clone)
description: RESOLVED via sanctioned OPTION 2 (test-only guard; writer SOURCE untouched). Added shared helper packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/fla8-fixture.ts exporting hasValidFla8Fixture(path) — returns false when the fixture is MISSING, 0-byte, < OLE2 header, or lacks the D0CF11E0 OLE2-CFB magic; never throws. Keys on magic+size, NOT a hardcoded skip, so the moment the real ~17KB binary is committed every guarded test auto-runs at FULL strength (forward-compatible). Guarded the 3 fixture-dependent gates with skip-reason 'flash8-empty.fla fixture absent or empty — provide the real binary to enable byte-match tests': empty-bytematch.test.ts (whole gate-1 describe via describe.runIf + a placeholder it.skip carrying the reason), carchive-validate.test.ts ('parses flash8-empty.fla Contents + Page 1 cleanly'), contents-structure.test.ts ('the real empty fixture has exactly 1 CDocumentPage,1 CColorDef,1 CQTAudioSettings'). writer-spec-bytes.test.ts only references the fixture in a comment (fixture-independent) — left untouched. NO assertions weakened. SANITY: temporarily dropping a valid OLE2 CFB (evaporatingdrip.fla) in as flash8-empty.fla made all 3 gates RUN (not skip) — proving the guard is magic-keyed, not a permanent skip. EVIDENCE (0-byte placeholder present): pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run src/fla => Test Files 27 passed | 1 skipped (28); Tests 363 passed | 8 skipped (371); 0 FAIL. Full core suite: Test Files 344 passed | 1 skipped; Tests 5528 passed | 8 skipped | 0 failed (was 7 failed). Full ordered build (pnpm --filter './packages/**' build) GREEN. The original ENOENT/0-byte dark-gate caveat is now CLEARED for fresh clones.
